description.value: Wood N Frog Coffee Company is a cozy café in Tsawwassen (Delta, BC) positioned close to the BC Ferries terminal—a natural refuelling point for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry. The café is known for artisan espresso drinks, freshly made sandwiches and wraps, and homemade baked goods including scones, croissants, and coconut cake. Gluten-free and vegetarian options are woven throughout the menu, and the welcoming atmosphere has earned it a loyal following among both locals and ferry travellers.
